title: 1936 Prairie's belvedere gets its corner pilasters and columned window frames
items: The lookout at the top of 1936 Prairie's tower now has a stone pilaster at every corner, running from its balcony up to the brackets under its cornice, as the old Chicagology photograph of the house shows. The storey below stays plain, as it is in the photograph.
Each of the lookout's four round-headed windows now sits in an arched frame with a slender column on each side, carrying the arch.
